headline: Making a Stateside Splash

result.label: Plus mass-market distribution: Target, Kroger, Walgreens, Walmart
result.note: The CPG industry page cites +20%; the case page does not — confirm with Renee before using the number

summary: A niche Japanese snack with big ambitions and a modest budget. We took the brand to the consumer — a cross-country Pocky convoy — and it landed in Target, Kroger, Walgreens and Walmart.

question.h: Big on ideas, modest on budget.
question.p: Pocky, a niche Japanese snack food, dreamed of upping the ante by getting more brand awareness in the U.S. The assignment was big on ideas, and modest on budget.

made.p: We brought the consumer to the brand, with a cross-country road trip replete with brand ambassadors, street teams, and free samples. To “share happiness” (their tag line) we created a Pocky convoy.

happened.h: Sales up, and onto the big shelves.
happened.p: The brand experienced a sales increase along with distribution in mass market, including Target, Kroger, Walgreens and Walmart.
